title: acer pictum subsp. glaucum
intro: Acer pictum subsp. glaucum, commonly known as Japanese Maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Japan. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Acer pictum subsp. glaucum include anti-anxiety and anti-stress effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may also contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenols that are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
